author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, author gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. For the map: detailed, immersive, classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites. No budget stated.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. Looking for artists that draw anime/manga, cartoon/semi-cartoon, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic, and any other art styles. Comment if interested or DM directly. Follow-up: author is checking portfolios; send a link to previous work if not already sent. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k. No budget stated.

title: Hiring remote 2D game artist (contract)
content: Hiring 2D Game Artist (Remote).
